name: Tsujidou-san no Jun'ai Road
original_name: 辻堂さんの純愛ロード
source:
Hiroshi was a student at Inamura Academy in Kanagawa Shounan and became interested in his delinquent classmate Tsujidou-san after seeing her help a kitty in the rain. But everyone around her are also delinquents, including her rivals Maki and Renna. The life of an ordinary guy like him just got a lot more troubled!

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/09/01/september-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
长谷大是神奈川县湘南稻村学院的学生。某天，他看到不良少女辻堂爱在雨中帮助一只小猫，便对她产生了兴趣。可围绕在她身边的也全是不良少年少女，包括她的竞争对手牧与恋奈。像长谷大这样的普通人，校园生活从此变得更加麻烦！

[引自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/09/01/september-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
